title: Ring in the New Year with this Wonderful Wakeup Casserole recipe - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Wonderful Wakeup Casserole recipe. Try this recipe today. Photo by Captured image/Aldi Starting 2026 with something special? This Wonderful Wakeup Casserole recipe is exactly what you need for New Year's Day brunch. After the midnight countdown and late-night celebrations, your family deserves a satisfying meal that doesn't require much effort.
This recipe, inspired by Aldi, one of my favorite places for groceries, combines smoky ham, crispy hash browns, and melted cheddar cheese in one glorious dish. The best part? Your slow cooker does all the work while you recover from last night's festivities.
The process is straightforward. Layer shredded hash browns in your slow cooker, then add diced hickory-smoked ham and cheddar cheese. Not a fan of ham, substitute that out for something else, or leave it out altogether. Repeat these layers to build flavor throughout. Whisk together eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl, then pour this mixture over everything. The slow cooker transforms these simple ingredients into something everyone will love.
Six hours of low cooking allows the flavors to blend together perfectly. The eggs set into a creamy base while the cheese melts into gooey pockets of goodness. Your kitchen will smell amazing, waking everyone up who is still in bed, and you won't have to stand over a stove flipping individual portions.
After the initial cook time , sprinkle more cheese and chopped green onions on top. Switch to high heat for 30 minutes to finish. The green onions add a fresh bite that cuts through the richness.
This casserole recipe serves about 10-12 people, making it perfect for hosting and sleepovers. Set it out and let everyone serve themselves. The combination of textures—from the tender eggs to the crispy hash browns—keeps each bite interesting.
It's foolproof, feeds a group, and tastes like you spent hours in the kitchen. Your New Year's Day just got easier.
Ingredients: Carlini Cooking Spray 30 oz. Season's Choice Shredded Hash Browns, divided 1 lb. Smithfield Hickory Smoked Ham Steak, diced, divided 3 cups Happy Farms Shredded Cheddar Cheese, divided 1 dozen Goldhen Large Eggs 1 cup Friendly Farms 2% Milk 1 tsp. Stonemill Iodized Salt 1 tsp. Stonemill Ground Black Pepper ¼ cup chopped green onions Directions: Heat slow cooker on low setting. Coat the inside with cooking spray. Arrange 1/2 hash browns around bottom of slow cooker. Top with 6 oz. of ham and 1 cup of cheese. Repeat with remaining hash browns, ham and 1 cup cheese. In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Pour eggs on top of layered ingredients and cover. Cook for 6 hours. Top with remaining cheese and green onions, adjust temperature to high and cook for 30 minutes, covered. Prep Time: 5 minutes | Cook Time: 6 hours, 30 minutes | Total Time: 6 hours, 35 minutes | Servings: 10-12
